audit.summary: A nonfaithful quotient action invalidates the final Lie-algebra inference in the central orbit-symmetry proof. Exact counterexamples establish three additional local defects. The geometric splitting conclusion is not refuted.

Zero induced field versus zero quotient-algebra element — Counterevidence: The action on M is effective and its orbits are symmetric. The intended geometric conclusion survives. Reading check-Z=0 as shorthand for a field still does not justify injectivity of the algebra map.
Incorrect backwards Gram-Schmidt vector and density — Counterevidence: The diagonal specialization is correct; no diagonal restriction is present in the general statement.
Missing absolute determinant in automorphism law — Counterevidence: Main application in Lemma 4.2 has determinant one and is not invalidated by this sign issue.
Same-group lifting fails for a flat circle — Counterevidence: Theorem 9.2 does not require M noncompact. A flat cylinder with S^1 x R action gives a related noncompact obstruction.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.

proposition.claim:
On pp. 17–18, the proof of Proposition 7.1 sets \(\Phi:\mathfrak q\to\mathfrak q/\mathfrak n\) and \(\check Z=\Phi(Z)\) for \(Z\in\mathfrak m\). Its Bochner calculation gives \(\check Z^{*}=0\) as a Killing field on \(N\backslash M\). It then concludes \(\check Z=0\) and \(Z=0\), invoking injectivity of \(\Phi|_{\mathfrak m\oplus\mathfrak a}\). The action of \(Q/N\) on \(N\backslash M\) has not been shown effective. Injectivity of \(\Phi\) on the indicated subspace does not make the map from \(\mathfrak q/\mathfrak n\) to Killing fields injective.

Assumption 5.2. Complete normalized negative Einstein manifold. Connected semisimple L without compact simple factors, finite center. Proper effective isometric cocompact action. Z in m; Phi:q->q/n.

The displayed u1 is the backwards orthogonal residual and yields the weighted density.

Three-dimensional Heisenberg algebra [e1,e2]=e3. Arbitrary positive-definite metric H. Standard orthonormal background.

v(h2)=det(phi)^(-1)*v(h1) for every such automorphism.

Connected nonabelian nilpotent Heisenberg group times R. h1=h2=standard correctly gauged background metric. phi=diag(1,1,1,-1) is an isometric Lie algebra automorphism.

G action lifts as the same group to the universal cover, giving G^0 subset Isom(R^k).

Complete Ricci-flat M. Effective proper isometric cocompact G action.
